briefdescription.para: Compute BM25+ score for a single document against a set of query terms.

detaileddescription.para: BM25+ formula per term t: score(t,d) = IDF(t) * [ (tf(t,d) * (k1+1)) / (tf(t,d) + k1*(1-b+b*dl/avgdl)) + delta ]
Parameters: k1 = 1.5, b = 0.75, delta = 0.5 (BM25+ lower-bound correction).

parameterdescription.para: Tokenised query terms (duplicates are summed).
Raw document text (whitespace-tokenised internally).
Corpus average document length in tokens.
Pre-computed IDF values per term. Missing terms → IDF 0.
